Name: errors
Doc: Package errors implements functions to manipulate errors.

Name: fmt
Doc: Package fmt implements formatted I/O with functions analogous to C's printf and scanf.

Name: id
Doc: Package id defines the identifiers of the domain as distinct types, so a commit sha cannot be passed where a change id is wanted and a malformed value cannot get past decoding.

Name: finding
Doc: Package finding models what reviewers submit and how a finding is judged: the agent-facing input schemas (FindingIn, Review), the evidence that backs a finding and the tier that evidence reaches, and the vocabulary of severities, categories and lifecycle states.

Name: testset
Doc: Package testset models what the test-author submits: the test files, the map from acceptance criteria to the tests that cover them, the paths the change expects to touch, and the assumptions the author made.

Name: archcheck
Doc: Package archcheck enforces the dependency rule of TECH_SPEC 2.2 and the test-code rule of D121 on the import graph, so a bad import fails the build whichever tool the author used.

Name: require
Doc: Package require implements the same assertions as the assert package but stops test execution when a test fails.
